moss.description: A tourism booking platform designed to help independent guides showcase experiences, manage availability, accept reservations, and operate their business from one place.
moss.heroAlt: Moss Project tourism website homepage featuring a Costa Rican tree frog
moss.challengeTitle1: Turning local tourism into a complete
moss.challengeCopy: Independent tour guides often rely on disconnected tools, messages and manual coordination to manage their business. Moss Project was designed to bring discovery, booking and day-to-day operations into one cohesive experience.
moss.solutionCopy: The platform combines a public tourism experience with a private administrative workspace, allowing visitors to explore tours and book departures while giving the guide control over tours, availability, reservations and payments.

stories.title: Tour discovery
stories.copy: A visual tour catalog helps travelers compare experiences, locations, duration and pricing before choosing their next adventure.

stories.title: Experience details
stories.copy: Each tour presents the essential information travelers need before booking, including imagery, pricing, duration, location and meeting point.
stories.alt: Moss Project tour detail page for Arenal Volcano and Hot Springs

stories.title: Booking flow
stories.copy: Travelers choose an available departure, enter their information and select a payment method through a guided reservation flow.
stories.alt: Moss Project available departure selection calendar

stories.title: Operations workspace
stories.copy: A dedicated administrative workspace brings tours, departures, reservations, manual payments, announcements and configuration into one interface.

stories.title: Booking self-service
stories.copy: Travelers can retrieve an existing reservation using their reference code and email address.

moss.bookingAlt: Moss Project traveler booking form and payment options
moss.operationsNote: The operational side uses a quieter interface so schedules and reservations remain easy to scan throughout the day.
moss.resultCopy: Moss Project connects the public booking journey with the operational tools required to manage a tourism business, creating one consistent system from discovery to reservation management.

logistica.description: A logistics management platform built to centralize customers, packages, assignments, tracking and day-to-day courier operations.
challengeParagraphs: Courier businesses manage a constant flow of customers, shipments, tracking numbers, package assignments and operational updates.
When that information is spread across manual processes and disconnected tools, everyday operations become slower and more prone to mistakes.
Logística SA needed a centralized platform where both staff and customers could interact with package information reliably.
logistica.solutionCopy: Oakflare built a centralized logistics platform combining customer management, package workflows, tracking, assignments and operational tools into a single production system.

screens.label: Operations center
screens.description: A centralized workspace for packages, customers, billing, pre-alerts, ACS synchronization and operational monitoring.

screens.label: Customer portal
screens.description: Customers can access their locker information, recent shipments, invoices and account activity from one place.

screens.label: Shipment tracking
screens.description: Package status, tracking numbers, estimated charges and shipment progress are available directly from the customer portal.

screens.label: Authentication experience
screens.description: A dedicated customer entry point designed to make account access clear and straightforward.

logistica.architectureCopy: The platform combines a React frontend with a FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL persistence and containerized production services, giving the application a maintainable foundation for real operational workloads.

architectureItems.title: Frontend
architectureItems.description: Responsive React interface for customers and operators.

architectureItems.title: API
architectureItems.description: FastAPI backend handling business logic and integrations.

architectureItems.title: Data
architectureItems.description: PostgreSQL database for customers, packages and operations.

architectureItems.title: Infrastructure
architectureItems.description: Dockerized production services deployed on Linux.

logistica.resultCopy: Logística SA centralizes the information and workflows required to manage customers and packages, giving the business greater visibility over its daily operations.
